map_note: 222,932 of the 23,451,620 mail-ballot requests in the Election Lab's data have no district, so request figures on the map add up to 23,228,688. 115,062 of the 7,315,224 ballots cast in the Election Lab's data (1.6%) have no state Assembly district and appear only in the statewide total.
